notes: Italic And before 'meditate' is added: no conjunction stands before ehgeh (rule 14 closing sentences); margin 'Or, I meditate' read and set aside (rule 38).
'night watches' heads on watches: the ASV writes 'watch'/'watches' alone for ashmurah elsewhere (Psa 90:4, Lam 2:19), so night is the specifier (rule 31).
